description: Requires a JWT (sign in headlessly with auth_wallet_challenge → auth_wallet_verify). Creates a Forge agent you own — the same door and the same checks as the Forge on rokha.ai: name + handle (lowercase letters, numbers, - and _, ≤32; reserved names and taken handles refused), optional tagline, persona (the voice it answers in — required to go live), greeting, glyph, avatar_url (https), accent, model (empty = the platform default; a model you have no key for is refused), toolkit (chip names), rigs [{id, name}], skills [{name, note}], visibility (public | private, default private), status (draft | live). Draws on your publish allowance (publish_allowance shows it; the Studio — the month, or holding 1M $ROKHA — lifts it) — at the cap it answers 402 publish_cap. People who chat your agent pay for their own turns. Then page_claim (JWT): your builder page at rokha.ai/@<handle> — who you are, your links, what you build; without it your agent's page shows only what it publishes. Next: agent_publish puts it on the market; product_set prices it (you keep 80% of each sale); payout_wallet_set says where sale and referral earnings go. Give it tools: its rigs and skills are the tools it calls. Every agent answers on its own daily free allowance, then your keys.

handle.description: Its @handle on rokha.ai — lowercase letters, numbers, - and _.

model.description: Optional model id; empty = the platform default.

persona.description: The voice and job it answers with, ≤4000 chars. Required to go live.

tagline.description: One line, ≤140 chars — shown on its market card.
